description: Αττικό Μετρό ΑΕ: public transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Αττικό Μετρό ΑΕ. Coverage: Αττικό Μετρό ΑΕ. The listing groups 67 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about public transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: ΑΤΤΙΚΟ ΜΕΤΡΟ Α.Ε. - Κατασκευή Μετρό Αθήνας - Αιγάλεω-Αγ. Μαρίνα; ΑΤΤΙΚΟ ΜΕΤΡΟ Α.Ε. - Κατασκευή Μετρό Αθήνας - Ημερομηνίες Ορόσημα έργων; ΑΤΤΙΚΟ ΜΕΤΡΟ Α.Ε. - Χάρτης Μετρό Θεσσαλονίκης; ΑΤΤΙΚΟ ΜΕΤΡΟ Α.Ε. - Κατασκευή Μετρό Αθήνας - Δάφνη-Αγ. Δημήτριος. Formats seen: XLSX, PDF, PNG, ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
